editor.body:
# Glow Booth - analysis

Instant-camera booth. logic.js is pure stamp math. app.js paints the stage. poses.js is a five-pose strip.

Risks: stamp helper may stop one short; restart may keep lastPose; no tests; no shuffle.

artifact.summary: a structured map of the app, on disk

booth.note: Fresh session. Try the poses - the app promises five stamps for five poses.

gate.name: Map exists
gate.prompt: Accept the map. Do not edit yet.

beats.claim: The command scans the tree, it does not guess.
beats.takeaway: Start with a map, not a guess.

beats.claim: The analysis file is the durable output.

scenes.title: Get a verdict on the bugs
scenes.intent: Now make the bugs visible. Capture all five poses in the booth: the meter reads 4 of 5. Then ask for a read-only review.
output: Read-only review. Findings ranked.
HIGH computeStamps stops at captured.length - 1, so a perfect set awards 4/5.
HIGH restartState keeps prev.lastPose, so Restart leaves the last pose on stage.
MED no tests. LOW pose order never shuffles.
VERDICT: GO-WITH-CONDITIONS - wrote docs/v0.1.0/review.md

editor.body:
# Review

- Stamp loop uses captured.length - 1
- Restart reuses the previous lastPose
- No Vitest files yet
- Shuffle is absent (feature, not a defect)

artifact.summary: ranked findings: stamps, restart, missing tests

booth.note: See it yourself: a perfect set reads 4 / 5. Now press Restart - the last pose stays on stage.

gate.name: Findings listed
gate.prompt: Confirm findings. Plan the bugfix only; leave shuffle for compare.

beats.claim: Review reads; it does not edit.
The report names stamps, restart, tests, and shuffle.
beats.takeaway: Pick a fix scope before coding.

scenes.title: Scope one gated phase
scenes.intent: Turn the findings into a plan with a written definition of done: fix the stamp count and the sticky Restart, prove both with tests, commit locally. Shuffle is deliberately out of scope.

tools.name: Read
tools.purpose: use analysis.md and review.md as inputs

output: Goal: a perfect set awards 5/5; Restart clears the last pose.
Phase 1 only. Definition of done: unit tests for computeStamps and restartState; one local commit; no push.
Wrote docs/releases/v0.1/plans/fix-stamps-and-restart.md with a GO / NO-GO gate

editor.body:
# Plan - fix stamps and restart

Phase 1: computeStamps walks the full captured array; restartState returns freshState(); add Vitest.

Lifecycle: one local commit. No push. Shuffle is out of scope.

artifact.summary: one phase, written DoD, local-commit contract

booth.note: Scope locked: the stamp count and the sticky Restart. Shuffle waits for /compare.

beats.claim: The plan is a gated phase, not a todo list.
The contract is local commit only.
beats.takeaway: Push waits for the final phase.

scenes.title: Fix both bugs, prove it, commit
scenes.intent: Run the phase. Watch the diff land, the tests pass, and the booth change behavior: five poses now stamp 5 of 5, and Restart really clears the stage.
output: Implementing phase 1. The quality gate requires tests.
logic.js: for (var i = 0; i < captured.length; i++)  [was length - 1]
logic.js: restartState() now returns freshState()  [no more sticky lastPose]
logic.test.js: expect(computeStamps(['dawn','neon','forest','studio','spark'])).toBe(5)
vitest run - 8 passed
One local commit created. No push.

artifact.summary: both bugs fixed, tests added, one local commit

booth.note: Same five poses - the meter now reads 5 / 5, and Restart clears the stage. Try it.

gate.name: Phase GO
gate.prompt: GO on the local commit. Do not push.

beats.claim: The editor shows the stamp and restart diff.
beats.takeaway: The phase edits only what the plan named.

beats.claim: Tests pass and the commit stays local.
beats.takeaway: A green phase is still not a release.

scenes.title: Learn from a reference, adopt the idea
scenes.intent: A sibling folder holds a nicer booth with shuffled poses and a sparkle when the meter fills. Compare against it and adopt the ideas - reverse-engineered, never imported wholesale.

tools.name: Write
tools.purpose: write the compare report and the from-comparison plan

output: Local path compare. Reverse-engineer first.
Worth adopting: shuffle(items) (Fisher-Yates) plus a sparkle overlay when the meter is full.
Not adopted wholesale: the reference stays a reference, never a dependency.
Wrote docs/v0.1.0/compare-booth.md - next: /plan from-comparison, then the same /implement loop as phase 1.

editor.body:
# Compare vs glow-booth-shuffle-reference

Adopt shuffle and the sparkle overlay. Do not import the reference as a dependency.

Next: /plan from-comparison, then the same /implement loop as phase 1.

artifact.summary: gap analysis plus an adoption plan

booth.note: The reference booth shuffles pose order and sparkles on a full meter. Ours does not - yet.

gate.name: Adopt shuffle
gate.prompt: Adopt shuffle from the reference. The follow-on /implement is the same command, not a new lesson.

beats.claim: Compare reads a local reference, not a SaaS.
beats.takeaway: Reverse-engineer the idea, copy nothing wholesale.

beats.claim: from-comparison chains into the same build loop.
beats.takeaway: Shuffle is this scene's outcome, not a ninth command.

scenes.title: Prove it all with a coverage gate
scenes.intent: After the shuffle phase lands the same way phase 1 did, drive the unit suite to the coverage threshold. The terminal is the proof; a number below the threshold is NO-GO.
output: Driving unit tests to the coverage threshold.
computeStamps full set -> 5. restartState -> lastPose is null. shuffle -> same members, order varies.
vitest run --coverage: Tests 12 passed
Statements 92% - above the project threshold. Gate: PASS

editor.body:
computeStamps full set -> 5
restartState -> lastPose is null
shuffle -> same members, not always the same order

artifact.summary: unit suite green; coverage above threshold

booth.note: Pose order is shuffled now - and 12 tests prove stamps, restart, and shuffle.

gate.name: Coverage gate
gate.prompt: Accept the suite. Ship only after tests.

beats.takeaway: Both the bugfix and shuffle are verified here.

beats.claim: Coverage is a gate, not a screenshot.
beats.takeaway: A number below the threshold is NO-GO.

scenes.title: Record it; the tag still waits
scenes.intent: Sync the written record. A full /update release would bump the version, tag, and publish - but only after a green integration. This example stops at the honest local record.
output: CHANGELOG.md updated:
- Fix Glow Booth stamp off-by-one and restart leak
- Shuffle poses and sparkle on a full meter (adopted from a local reference)
Release stays blocked until integration is green. No tag is invented.

editor.body:

beats.claim: Ship is documentation plus a gate.
beats.takeaway: The record is real; the tag is not automatic.

beats.claim: Integration still has to be green.
beats.takeaway: Communicate after the work is real.
